name: sahut
description: Chatbot layanan pelanggan multi-channel (web, WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord) dengan basis pengetahuan per bisnis.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,dashboard,widget -c green,blue,gray "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w dashboard" "npm run dev -w widget"
scripts.build: npm run build -w widget && npm run build -w dashboard && npm run build -w server
